# Homebrew Tap (Locksmith)

> Dedicated Homebrew tap distributing codesigned Locksmith binaries, MCP server, and CyberArk Summon provider with macOS biometric entitlements.

## Core Capabilities
- Biometric Entitlement Packaging: Distributes codesigned Locksmith binaries preserving macOS Secure Enclave entitlements.
- Multi-Binary Distribution: Delivers `locksmith` CLI, Model Context Protocol server, and CyberArk Summon provider in one formula.
- Apple Silicon ARM64 & Intel x86_64 Support.

## Usage
- `brew tap bonjoski/locksmith`: Adds dedicated tap.
- `brew install bonjoski/locksmith/locksmith`: Installs codesigned Locksmith binaries.
- `brew upgrade bonjoski/locksmith/locksmith`: Updates to latest release.

## Documentation
- Parent Runbook: `docs/knowledge-base/11-distribution-tap.md` in repository `spanreed`
